title: The Sediment Channel Where Stone Learns to Follow

features.name: shopfront-remains
features.desc-on-touch: A storefront learning to be stone. The sign has worn smooth, the counter dissolved. Now it flows downstream grain by grain.

features.name: shed-foundation
features.desc-on-touch: Where a shelter stood. Layers of memory and sediment, each stratum a year of living and weather.

features.name: stone-becoming-sand
features.desc-on-touch: The moment rock learns it is not permanent. Grain by grain, matter discovers its own fluidity.

features.name: flow-channel
features.desc-on-touch: The path sediment takes. The route where slowness learns its own momentum.

features.name: grain-choir
features.desc-on-touch: Millions of particles singing the same song: we are becoming water. We are becoming river.

inscription: the shop learns it was only stone pretending to be permanence

file.note: A recording of the sediment channel at dusk. The sound of commerce dissolving into geology.
